+++ b/app/api/handlers.py
@@ -11,3 +11,11 @@
     if user is None:
         return 404, {"error": "not found"}
     return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_user_exists(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    return 200, {"exists": user is not None}

command:
cat > tests/test_handlers.py <<EOF
import pytest
from app.api import handlers

def test_handle_user_exists_success():
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"exists": True})
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"exists": False})

def test_handle_user_exists_invalid_input():
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handlers.handle_user_exists({"id": "1.2"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
EOF
pytest tests/test_handlers.py
